title: Disney TV & Channel
description: Disney Channel originals, animated TV, Disney+ shows.

questions.prompt: Who played Hannah Montana?
questions.explanation: Miley Cyrus (real name Destiny Hope Cyrus) played both Miley Stewart and her pop-star alter ego across four seasons from 2006 to 2011.

questions.prompt: What is Phineas and Ferb's pet platypus named?
questions.explanation: Perry the Platypus leads a double life as Agent P, a secret agent for the O.W.C.A. who battles Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

questions.prompt: In Kim Possible, what is the name of her sidekick?
questions.explanation: Ron Stoppable, voiced by Will Friedle, is Kim's bumbling best friend who later becomes her boyfriend across the show's 2002-2007 run.

questions.prompt: Who played the title character in Lizzie McGuire?
questions.explanation: Hilary Duff starred as Lizzie from 2001 to 2004, with an animated inner-Lizzie cartoon voicing her unspoken thoughts.

questions.prompt: What are the names of the twin brothers in The Suite Life of Zack & Cody?
questions.explanation: Identical twins Dylan and Cole Sprouse played Zack and Cody Martin, who lived in the Tipton Hotel where their mom worked as a singer.

questions.prompt: In Gravity Falls, what are the twins' names?
questions.explanation: Dipper and Mabel Pines spend a summer in Oregon with Grunkle Stan; creator Alex Hirsch voices both Stan and Soos.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the high school in High School Musical?
questions.explanation: East High is based on a real Salt Lake City school where the 2006 film was shot; its hallways still draw Disney fans today.

questions.prompt: Who played Raven Baxter in That's So Raven?
questions.explanation: Raven-Symoné had already starred on The Cosby Show as a child before leading That's So Raven from 2003 to 2007.

questions.prompt: What is the family surname in Wizards of Waverly Place?
questions.explanation: The Russo family runs a sandwich shop on Waverly Place in Greenwich Village while the three kids compete to keep their wizard powers.

questions.prompt: Who played Alex Russo in Wizards of Waverly Place?
questions.explanation: Selena Gomez played Alex from 2007 to 2012, winning the family wizard competition and launching her music and acting career.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Kim Possible's naked mole rat?
questions.explanation: Rufus lives in Ron Stoppable's pocket and was voiced by Nancy Cartwright, who also voices Bart Simpson.

questions.prompt: In Phineas and Ferb, what is the evil scientist's name?
questions.explanation: Heinz Doofenshmirtz, voiced by co-creator Dan Povenmire, runs Doofenshmirtz Evil Incorporated and invents a new '-inator' each episode.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the town in Gravity Falls?
Who is the great-uncle running the Mystery Shack in Gravity Falls?
questions.explanation: Stanley Pines runs the tourist-trap Mystery Shack while secretly trying to rescue his twin brother Ford from another dimension.

questions.prompt: In DuckTales, what is the name of Scrooge McDuck's money vault building?
questions.explanation: Scrooge swims through his cash in the Money Bin atop Killmotor Hill in Duckburg, a gag created by cartoonist Carl Barks in 1953.

questions.prompt: What are the names of Donald Duck's three nephews?
questions.explanation: Huey, Dewey, and Louie debuted in a 1937 newspaper comic; in the 2017 DuckTales reboot they were finally given distinct personalities.

questions.prompt: In The Owl House, what is the name of the human protagonist?
questions.explanation: Luz Noceda is a Dominican-American teen and Disney's first openly bisexual lead character, voiced by Sarah-Nicole Robles.

questions.prompt: What Disney Junior show features a young pirate named Jake?
questions.answer: Jake and the Never Land Pirates
questions.explanation: Jake and the Never Land Pirates ran from 2011 to 2016 and is set in Peter Pan's Neverland, with Captain Hook as the recurring villain.

questions.prompt: In Recess, what is the name of the leader of the kids' gang?
questions.explanation: Theodore Jasper 'T.J.' Detweiler leads the playground gang of six at Third Street School; Recess aired on ABC's One Saturday Morning from 1997.

questions.prompt: Who played Miranda, Lizzie McGuire's best friend?
questions.explanation: Lalaine Vergara-Paras played Miranda Sanchez but didn't appear in the show's final season, with the character said to be visiting Mexico City.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Hannah Montana's brother on the show?
questions.explanation: Jackson Stewart, played by Jason Earles, is Miley's older brother; Earles was 28 when cast as a high schooler.

questions.prompt: In That's So Raven, what is Raven's special ability?
questions.explanation: Raven gets brief psychic flashes that she usually misinterprets, driving each episode's comedic chaos.

questions.prompt: What Disney Junior show stars a Latina princess and her amulet?
questions.explanation: Elena of Avalor (2016-2020) was Disney's first Latina princess franchise; her Amulet of Avalor traps the sorceress Shuriki for 41 years.

questions.prompt: In WandaVision, what is the name of the town the series is set in?
questions.explanation: Westview, New Jersey is the suburb Wanda magically traps under the Hex; the 2021 series was the first Marvel show on Disney+.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the hotel in The Suite Life of Zack & Cody?
questions.explanation: The Tipton Hotel is a parody of the Hilton, with heiress London Tipton standing in for Paris Hilton.
